stem: One way the U.S. government responded to the problems caused by the conditions in this list was by —

options.label: G
options.text: implementing the silver standard for currency

options.label: H
options.text: creating a federal jobs program for the unemployed

options.label: J

visual_elements:
Reasons for Economic Problems of the Gilded Age
• Rapid growth of trusts and monopolies
• Ruthless business tactics of robber barons
• Use of unfair practices by the railroads such as rebates, pools, and differential rates
